title: Sebi to review derivatives settlement price methodology after CAS volatility

A consultation paper on proposed changes will be issued soon.

title: Tyson Foods cuts annual profit forecast again as beef pressure drains margins
description: Tyson Foods has revised down its profit and sales targets for fiscal 2026 due to rising challenges within the beef segment. The company anticipates that declining cattle prices will adversely impact its margins. To adapt to these industry-wide cattle-cycle dynamics, Tyson Foods plans to either close or sell three of its beef plant operations.

title: Campbell's forecasts weak year ahead on pressured consumer spending
description: Campbell's is aiming for substantial cost savings by 2030, after announcing a cut to its quarterly dividend to focus on debt reduction. In a surprising turn, the company's fourth-quarter revenue fell more sharply than expected by analysts. In this context, many lower-income consumers are moving to more affordable brands and store labels, leading Campbell's to revise prices across its entire product range.

title: US Fed's Christopher Waller urges 'give disinflation a chance' as rate hike remains on table
